author: Calvin C. Moore and Joseph A. Wolf
title: Square integrable representations of nilpotent groups
publication: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 185 (1973), 445–462
statement_used: For an irreducible representation square integrable modulo the centre of a unimodular group, matrix-coefficient orthogonality has one positive formal degree.
dictionary: Use the general theorem at the beginning of the paper. The real unitary group has compact centre. With centre of mass one, the product of the two coefficients descends and integration on the central quotient agrees with integration on the group. The quotient Haar measure is fixed by the given group Haar measure.

author: Lars Hörmander
title: The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators I
statement_used: For a smooth real phase with a nondegenerate stationary point and smooth compactly supported amplitude, the leading coefficient has the Hessian determinant and signature factors, with a remainder one order smaller controlled by finitely many derivatives.
dictionary: The real part of the holomorphic orbital phase has critical points indexed by s-th roots with signature zero. Compact determinant annuli and a fixed positive Gram cutoff give uniform bounds for the required derivatives.
